headlines.description: — Trae Young had 21 points, nine assists and seven rebounds, AJ Dybantsa scored 17 points in his home debut, and the Washington Wizards routed the Charlotte Hornets 95-79 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: AJ Dybantsa sharp in his home debut as the Wizards smother Charlotte 95-79
